core_obligations: Identify the degree zero part (proof lines 2496-2505): the global sections of the structure sheaf are the base ring, the maximal ideal is contained in the sections of the ideal sheaf, and the containment is strict because the special fibre is nonempty, so the sections of the ideal sheaf are exactly the maximal ideal; since the powers of the ideal sheaf are the extended powers of the maximal ideal, the vanishing lemma for globally generated modules gives the vanishing of the first cohomology of every power.

Produce an induction (proof lines 2507-2531): choosing generators of the maximal ideal gives a surjection from a finite free module onto the ideal sheaf whose kernel is finite locally free of rank one less than the number of generators; the kernel twisted by the ideal sheaf is globally generated, hence so are its tensor powers; the resulting short exact sequences and the vanishing of the first cohomology of the twisted kernel show that every section of a power of the ideal sheaf is a combination of the generators with coefficients sections of the previous power, which identifies the sections of every power with the corresponding power of the maximal ideal by induction.
proof_roadmap: Compute the sections of the ideal sheaf as the maximal ideal and get vanishing of the first cohomology from global generation.
Build the surjection from a free module onto the ideal sheaf and control the twisting of its kernel.
Run the induction on the exact sequences to identify the sections of all powers.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that in the rational situation with the special fibre an effective Cartier divisor, the sections of every power of the ideal sheaf of the exceptional divisor are the corresponding power of the maximal ideal and the first cohomology of that power vanishes (statement lines 2487-2495). The proof (proof lines 2496-2531) computes the sections of the ideal sheaf, uses global generation for the vanishing statement, and runs an exact sequence induction with the kernel of the presentation of the ideal sheaf to identify the sections of all powers. H2: a complete standard computation in two steps.
